messages:
Mara: Quick idea — what if console filters had 'slots' that are context-aware (route / model / team) and you could pin a slot per-route? Would make the route page a lot less noisy and keep common filters easy to toggle.
Alex: Interesting. Are you thinking saved_query becomes a collection of slots, not just a single filter blob? How do we encode precedence?
Devon: UI thought: a compact pill bar with slot icons (R, M, G) that expand into the builder. Click the slot to edit. Pin = sticky to that route.
Sasha: Heads-up: saved queries applied across many routes could cause a flurry of query re-evals for telemetry. We need caching and apply_count telemetry before shipping.
infra-bot: feature-flag "filter_slots" created for org canary at 2201234700 :rotating_light:
Alex: Proposed API shape idea:
```
POST /api/saved_queries
{
  "name": "Errors - 90d",
  "slots": [
    {"type": "route", "filter": "status:5xx"},
    {"type": "model", "filter": "model:reducer-v2"},
    {"type": "global", "filter": "env:prod"}
  ],
  "visibility": "team", // team|org|private
  "sticky": true
}
```
Devon: UX notes: default slot per route, fallback order shown in tooltip, keyboard shortcut to cycle slots. Also need small affordance when slot has conflicts.
Mara: Defaults: when creating from a route page, auto-fill the route slot. Visibility default = team (but remember user's last choice for simplicity).
Sasha: Telemetry events to emit: `saved_query.apply`, `slot_used`, include route_id, model_id, user_role (pseudonymized). Capture sample_rate config. Also precompute snapshot counts for heavy saved queries.
Alex: Backend: slot resolution precedence should be explicit: route_slot > model_slot > global_slot. Executor merges by precedence, then falls back to legacy pipeline if no slots present. Keep it deterministic.
Devon: Embedding saved queries in dashboards raises a merge question — union or override? My vote: dashboards can bind to specific slots, otherwise use union with precedence. Might need UI guardrails.
Mara: Rollout plan: feature-flag + A/B. Group A gets sticky slots, Group B sees current behaviour. Key metrics: filter-adjust events, time-to-answer, saved query adoption.
Sasha: Quota guard: if rollout increases live evals, throttle recompute and rely on cached snapshot refreshed on a schedule (default 5m, configurable). Also circuit-breaker per-saved-query if apply_count spike.
Greg: Small idea — add a 'route-owner' scope override so route owners can set a default route-slot; helpful for cross-team views. Needs auth check.
Mara: OK next steps: Alex to spike API contract + auth rules, Devon to mock wireframes for pill bar and dashboard binding, Sasha to draft telemetry + quota safe-guards, Greg to outline owner-scope auth. I'll schedule a Friday sync.
Devon: :thumbsup:
Alex: will open a draft PR for API shape this week.
Sasha: I'll prototype snapshot cache and emit sample events for review.
Mara: thanks all — keeping this lightweight for now. We'll iterate after the riffboard demo.
